change_summary: Research-only offered market rung identity audit: block absent, nonnumeric, nonfinite, overlarge, scientific exponent and overprecision spread/total/team-total lines; preserve ML blank and valid signed and quarter rungs; tests. No source authentication, card eligibility, formulas or stakes.
assumptions: The allowed range and decimal precision are conservative safety bounds for an offline market-identity census, not an assertion about every future sportsbook product.
Original source and price claims are not independently authenticated by numeric line validation.
Regression tests use synthetic local data and cannot demonstrate true +EV or source provenance.
No production betting, frozen v5, prior projections, historic quote/grade artifacts or risk rules are changed.
